title: Bad-Habit Trigger Time-of-Day
dataSources: Alcohol drinks (`alcohol:drink`), vice logs (`vice:log`), hydration intake (`hydration:intake`), swear-jar entries (`swearjar:entry`).
app: Habit and sobriety trackers, alcohol-unit and hydration logs, vaping/smoking cessation apps, and a smart swear jar — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vice:log
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as uses by hour
| sort - uses
description: Maps when your slip-ups cluster through the day, revealing the trigger times to plan around.
value: Habits are cued by moments; knowing that mid-afternoon is your weak spot lets you prepare a healthier alternative.
implementation: Ingest vice logs into `index=personal`; review counts by hour to find trigger windows.
visualization: Column chart of habit slips by hour of day.
grandmaExplanation: It shows what times of day you tend to slip up, so you can plan around your weak moments.
